Topic at a glance
BCI Rules Part VI — Duties to Court, Client, Opponent & Colleagues (BCI Rules Part VI) is a registered chapter in Professional Ethics. BCI Rules Part VI — Duties to Court, Client, Opponent & Colleagues (BCI Rules Part VI) is governed by Advocates Act, 1961 and Bar Council of India Rules, especially Part VI, Chapter II. identify the conduct, applicable BCI rule, disciplinary forum, limitation or procedural stage, and distinguish professional misconduct from contempt of court and ordinary negligence.

Courtroom and evidentiary roadmap
Competent forum: the State Bar Council disciplinary committee, Bar Council of India on appeal or transfer, and the Supreme Court under the statutory appellate route; contempt jurisdiction remains distinct. the disciplinary authority must establish professional misconduct on the record, while the advocate receives notice, a fair hearing and an opportunity to answer the charge. Where electronic records are relied upon, apply BSA 2023 s. 63 and the applicable burden provisions without treating electronic admissibility as proof of the ultimate fact. Identify limitation, notice, maintainability, alternative remedy and the exact relief sought.
